lines.narrationArabic: تتراكم الطلبات قبل السوق الكبير، ويشعر الفريق بالضغط.

lines.targetText: 早上好，莱斯。周六之前还有很多事情要做。
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. There is a lot to do before Saturday.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا ليث. There is a lot to do before Saturday.
lines.pronunciation: zǎo shàng hǎo, lái sī. zhōu liù zhī qián hái yǒu hěn duō shì qíng yào zuò.

lines.targetText: 早上好。是的，我今天感到压力很大。
lines.englishReference: Good morning. Yes, I feel under pressure today.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. Yes, I feel under pressure today.
lines.pronunciation: zǎo shàng hǎo. shì de, wǒ jīn tiān gǎn dào yā lì hěn dà.

lines.targetText: 什么可以帮助我们保持冷静？
lines.englishReference: What can help us stay calm?
lines.arabicTranslation: What can help us stay calm?
lines.pronunciation: shén me kě yǐ bāng zhù wǒ men bǎo chí lěng jìng.

lines.englishReference: We can divide the work clearly.
lines.arabicTranslation: We can divide the work clearly.
lines.pronunciation: wǒ men kě yǐ qīng chǔ dì fēn gōng.

lines.targetText: 你能为团队列一个清单吗？
lines.englishReference: Can you make a list for the team?
lines.arabicTranslation: Can you make a list for the team?
lines.pronunciation: nǐ néng wèi tuán duì liè yí gè qīng dān ma.

lines.englishReference: Yes, I will write it now.
lines.arabicTranslation: Yes, I will write it now.
lines.pronunciation: shì de, wǒ xiàn zài jiù xiě.

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.
lines.pronunciation: zhè tīng qǐ lái shì gè hǎo jì huà.

lines.englishReference: The market is changing quickly this season.
lines.pronunciation: běn jì shì chǎng biàn huà hěn kuài.

lines.targetText: 是的。人们对古老道路提出了更多问题。
lines.englishReference: Yes. People are asking more questions about old roads.
lines.arabicTranslation: نعم. الناس يسألون أكثر عن الطرق القديمة.
lines.pronunciation: shì de. rén men duì gǔ lǎo dào lù tí chū le gèng duō wèn tí.
